capabilities.title: Seedance 2.0 Features & Workflows
capabilities.description: Start with the material you have, then use the available controls to shape the result.

items.title: Text to Video
items.description: Describe a subject, its action, the camera, and the setting. Use a focused shot description to turn an idea into a short clip.

items.title: Image to Video
items.description: Animate a first frame, guide a transition with first and last frames, or use reference images. Describe the motion you want to add.

items.title: Video to Video
items.description: Provide a reference video URL and describe the change you want. Available models and output settings are listed below.

items.title: Output & Audio Controls
items.description: Choose the supported duration, aspect ratio, resolution, and generated-audio option. Audio generation is different from uploading an audio reference.

specifications.title: Seedance 2.0 Specifications & Credits
specifications.description: Compare inputs, limits, and a 10-second 720p credit example for each model. Numbers come from the same configuration the generator uses.

inputItems.title: Text prompts
inputItems.description: Describe the subject, movement, camera, environment, and visual style.

inputItems.title: Image inputs
inputItems.description: Choose a first frame, first and last frames, or reference images in Image to Video. Upload limits are shown by the selected model.

inputItems.title: Reference video URL
inputItems.description: Use a video URL in Video to Video. The generated-audio switch does not provide an audio-upload workflow.

limitsItems.title: Fast and Mini
limitsItems.description: Resolution goes up to 720p. 1080p is available on Standard.

specifications.limitsNote: Configuration availability does not guarantee that a provider is available at every moment.
specifications.tip: Browsing and configuring is available before sign-in. Submitting a task requires an account and sufficient credits. Review the generator estimate before submitting; plans and credit packs are listed on the pricing page.

useCases.title: Seedance 2.0 Use Cases
useCases.description: Pick a scenario, then choose a keyword that matches your source material and workflow.

items.title: Advertising & Marketing
items.description: Turn product shots and brand assets into short clips for ads, landing pages, and campaign tests—without a full shoot.

items.title: Social Media & Short-form
items.description: One clear action, vertical-friendly framing, and fast iterations for feeds where motion stops the scroll.

items.title: Character & Animation
items.description: Animate from a reference image with controlled motion—validate faces, hands, and continuity before you ship.

items.title: Film & Pre-Production
items.description: Explore camera moves, lighting, and blocking in short loops before committing to a full production day.

howTo.title: How to Use Seedance 2.0
howTo.description: Prompt formula: subject + action + camera + environment + style. For example: a ceramic mug, steam rising, a slow push-in, on a sunlit desk, natural product photography.

items.title: Add a prompt or reference
items.description: Choose Text to Video, Image to Video, or Video to Video. Add the material required by that workflow.

items.title: Select model and settings
items.description: Select a Seedance 2.0 model. Set the available duration, aspect ratio, resolution, and generated-audio option.

items.title: Review credits and generate
items.description: Review the estimate and sign in to submit. Check the completed result before downloading or iterating.

faq.title: Seedance 2.0 FAQ
faq.description: Practical answers about models, output settings, access, and credits.

items.question: Which Seedance 2.0 models are available here?
items.answer: Fast, Standard, and Mini. Mini does not include Video to Video. The generator shows the models available for the workflow you select.

items.question: What is the difference between Fast, Standard, and Mini?
items.answer: They differ by resolution, workflow support, and credit cost. Standard includes 1080p. Mini is the lower-cost option without Video to Video. Use the table above for the current numbers; the names are not a quality ranking.

items.question: How long can Seedance 2.0 videos be?
items.answer: Duration depends on the model and workflow. Text and image workflows currently offer a wider range than Video to Video. Check the specifications table and the generator control before generating.

items.question: Which model supports 1080p?
items.answer: Standard supports 1080p. Fast and Mini currently go up to 720p.

items.question: Can I create vertical 9:16 videos?
items.answer: Yes. Choose 9:16 in the aspect-ratio control and frame the subject for a vertical shot.

items.question: Can I turn a product photo into a video?
items.answer: Yes. Choose Image to Video, upload your product image, and describe the movement and camera. Review the output for product-detail accuracy before publishing.

items.question: How many credits does a 720p example video cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on model, workflow, duration, and resolution. The table above shows a 10-second 720p example for each model. Confirm the generator estimate before submitting.

items.question: Does Mini support video-to-video?
items.answer: No. Choose Fast or Standard for Video to Video.

items.question: Is Seedance 2.0 free to use?
items.answer: You can browse and configure the generator before signing in. Submitting a generation requires an account and sufficient credits; the estimate is shown before submission.

items.question: Is this the official website, and does this page provide an API?
items.answer: Seadance Video is an independent third-party platform. This page provides a browser-based generator, not an API endpoint.
